dedupe_keys.name: automatic mcintosh based occurrence probability of solar activity

description: AMOS converts McIntosh sunspot classes and changes in active-region area into flare probabilities. It uses NOAA region summaries and historical GOES flare occurrence to estimate C-, M- and X-class events. The resource is documented by Kyung Hee University. The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (Flare Scoreboard). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The historical calibration period differs from the period of a prospective forecast. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
